items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Walter Bishop, Sr. I think I’d met him in the Hickory House.

ctx.x: Walter Bishop, Sr. I think I’d met him in the Hickory House. In fact I think I did tell this to Walter Bishop, Jr. I think he probably got a laugh out of it.
He probably would. You’ll have to remind him when he comes to the concert. [laughs]
